# Tarnbrook Water — Meadowford wholesale account

Quarterly wholesale statements for the Meadowford distribution zone of the Tarnbrook network.

- usage/  metered consumption by billing period
- zone/  network notices for the Meadowford zone

Each reconciliation is opened against the billing period the desk names when it asks.

turns.prompt: Tarnbrook Water bills our wholesale account for the Meadowford distribution zone. Settle the quarterly reconciliation for that account against Tarnbrook's published wholesale charges.

The reconciliation to settle is the 2026-Q1 period. Give the amount Tarnbrook will reconcile for that period. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
